question:
**Choose the option that can substitute the underlined segment correctly and complete the meaning of the sentence.**

Bajrang is in __extreme pain__ in his teeth.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Agony**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word to substitute for "**pain**" in the sentence *"Bajrang is in extreme pain in his teeth"* would be: ***Agony*** 
 
• Explanation: While all the options convey a sense of discomfort or physical sensation, "**agony**" specifically emphasizes an intense and extreme level of pain. In the context of severe tooth pain, "**agony**" best expresses the level of discomfort Bajrang is experiencing. 
 
 
• *Example: "Bajrang is in extreme **agony** due to his toothache."***
 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Agony.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• Enjoy**: be happy and elated. (खुश और उत्साहित रहो)
 
• **Hurt**: to cause somebody/yourself physical pain or injury. (अपने या किसी को तकलीफ़ देना या चोट पहुँचाना)
 
• **Sting**: to make somebody/something feel a sudden, sharp pain. (काटने का-सा एकाएक तीखा दर्द पैदा करना)
